title: From Anshan to Empire
question: How did a king of Anshan found the largest empire of his time?
hook: A king of Anshan took on the great powers around him and won.
idea: Cyrus built the empire by defeating Media, Lydia and Babylon in turn, and at its peak it was the largest empire of its time.

beats.prompt: Put these steps in Cyrus's rise in order
items: Cyrus defeats the Medes and takes Ecbatana (550 BC)
Cyrus dies and Cambyses II succeeds him (530 BC)
beats.explain: Media fell first, then Lydia, then Babylon, and Cyrus died years later.

beats.prompt: Cyrus defeats the Medes and takes their capital. Peoples who had paid tribute to the Medes now face a new ruler. What do many of them do?

choices.label: They accept the new ruler without question
choices.feedback: A change of ruler might look like a simple handover, but many tributaries saw an opening.

choices.label: They revolt, believing their situation had changed
They join forces to invade Persis
choices.feedback: The tributaries are described as revolting against Cyrus, not as launching a joint invasion.

beats.explain: When power passed from the Medes to the Persians, many tributaries believed their situation had changed and revolted, forcing Cyrus to fight wars against Bactria and the Saka.

beats.prompt: Match each figure to the role described
pairs: Conquered the empire entirely in 330 BC
Succeeded Cyrus as his eldest son
King of Lydia, whose kingdom fell in 546 BC
beats.explain: Each person marks a turning point in the empire's rise, succession or end.

beats.prompt: Sort each place by what happened with the empire
beats.explain: Cyrus defeated Media, Lydia and the Neo-Babylonian Empire, while the empire was repulsed from Scythia and Greece.
